finding.description: An impossible source ordinal with self-consistent synthetic IDs, or altered entity/source ordinal_basis, was accepted as complete retained lineage.

synthetic_probes.case: source ordinal TABLE_ROWS[sources]+1, recomputed record_id=digest([snapshot_id,sources,ordinal]) and entity_id

reviewed_safeguards: All tokens must match name-bearing strings in one source alias; no alias splicing or metadata-use match.
Escaped bound literal percent/underscore/exclamation, bounded request/page/response and source-order cursor.
Raw row hash, projection/native values, selected derivation/file/adapter keys and native locator parent/hash/claimant checks.
Exact source population control; missing observation/source stays partial.
Source permission registration is explicit and absence is not permission; every consumer purpose stays held.
Names/entities/roles/sites remain separate; no reported-city exclusion, clinical identity, current practice or network inference.

existing_actual_audit.scope: Historical pre-correction exact code binding; no current-code actual PostgreSQL replay by this reviewer.

limitations: Unit fixtures exercise Python guards and SQL binding, not PostgreSQL JSONPath/ILIKE evaluation. The existing eight-query actual audit covers its declared cases; root will issue a new code-bound replay after freeze.
SQL uses PostgreSQL ILIKE/collation while defensive Python matching uses casefold; this is not a claim of complete Unicode-normalized name discovery. No-result remains scoped unknown.
No customer identity, office selection, network or source-release acceptance is established.
